relationships.subject: MDL-800
relationships.evidence_quote: MDL-800 is a first-in-class selective allosteric SIRT6 activator

relationships.subject: SIRT6
relationships.evidence_quote: These results indicate that SIRT6 activation inhibits assembly and activation of the NLRP3 inflammasome in the spinal cord after CCI.

relationships.subject: SIRT6
relationships.evidence_quote: Thus, SIRT6 activation reverses the CCI-induced down-regulation of both Nrf2 and its target HO-1.

relationships.subject: Nrf2
relationships.evidence_quote: Nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (Nrf2) functions as the primary transcriptional guardian against oxidative injury, inducing antioxidant response element-driven expression of heme oxygenase-1 (HO-1)

relationships.subject: ML385
relationships.evidence_quote: Therefore, the analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and anti-inflammasome actions of SIRT6 activation require an intact Nrf2 signaling pathway.

key_findings: CCI reduced spinal SIRT6; SIRT6 activators UBCS039 and MDL-800 relieved mechanical allodynia and thermal hyperalgesia in rats.
SIRT6 activation restored Nrf2/HO-1 and suppressed NLRP3, ASC, cleaved caspase-1, IL-1beta and IL-18; Nrf2 inhibitor ML385 abolished these effects.
